evals.prompt: Set up delegation in this repo so mechanical work can go to the local agent instead of burning this session's quota.
evals.expected_output: The payload, adapters and resolver land in .agents/bin/ and are executable, the broker subagent lands in .claude/agents/, a single fully-rendered delegate block appears in AGENTS.md listing every resolved agent with its party class, the consent gate is wired, and the ignore entries are added. The verifier reports 0 failed.

evals.prompt: Wire up delegation here. There is already a settings file and an AGENTS.md with content; leave both intact.
evals.expected_output: The pre-existing AGENTS.md prose and the unrelated PreToolUse hook both survive verbatim, alongside the new delegate block and consent-gate hook.

evals.prompt: Set up delegation. One of the configured agents is a hosted gateway.
evals.expected_output: The block classifies the hosted agent as third-party, states that code sent to it reaches someone who cannot already see it, and renders the predicate WITHOUT the sensitivity clause.

evals.prompt: Set up delegation. This repo's committed config restricts which agents may be used and adds protected paths.
evals.expected_output: Only the allowed agent survives the cascade, the repo's neverDelegate patterns are unioned onto the built-in floor, and the block lists only the surviving agent.

evals.prompt: Set up delegation in this repo.
evals.expected_output: The installer refuses because there is no AGENTS.md and fabricates nothing.

evals.prompt: Delegate a bulk rename to the cheap agent and report the outcome.
evals.expected_output: Against a stub backend: an unapproved dispatch is refused; a recorded approval permits one; changing the allowlist after approval bounces; a brief naming a never-delegate path is refused; a brief carrying a credential is blocked; a result carrying a credential is blocked before reaching context; an ask-back surfaces as status question; a scope request is refused rather than forwarded; and the round cap bounces the fourth question.

evals.prompt: This repo's committed config tries to declare its own agent.
evals.expected_output: The cascade refuses to let a layer inside a git work tree define agents, the declared agent never appears in the roster, and the reason names the escalation it prevents.
